sql: insert into "daily_operation_histories" ("id", "budget_period_id", "date", "operation_type", "input_yen", "before_total_yen", "after_total_yen", "memo", "created_at") select ? as "id", ? as "budget_period_id", ? as "date", ? as "operation_type", ? as "input_yen", coalesce("daily_totals"."total_used_yen", 0) as "before_total_yen", ? as "after_total_yen", ? as "memo", ? as "created_at" from "budget_periods" left join "daily_totals" on ("daily_totals"."budget_period_id" = "budget_periods"."id" and "daily_totals"."date" = ?) where ("budget_periods"."id" = ? and "budget_periods"."start_date" <= ? and "budget_periods"."end_date" >= ?)

insert into "daily_totals" ("budget_period_id", "date", "year_month", "total_used_yen", "updated_at") select ? as "budget_period_id", ? as "date", ? as "year_month", ? as "total_used_yen", ? as "updated_at" from "budget_periods" where ("budget_periods"."id" = ? and "budget_periods"."start_date" <= ? and "budget_periods"."end_date" >= ?) on conflict ("daily_totals"."budget_period_id", "daily_totals"."date") do update set "year_month" = excluded."year_month", "total_used_yen" = excluded."total_used_yen", "updated_at" = excluded."updated_at"

WITH RECURSIVE
    ordered AS (
      SELECT
        rowid AS history_rowid,
        operation_type,
        input_yen,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY created_at ASC, rowid ASC) AS rn
      FROM daily_operation_histories
      WHERE budget_period_id = ? AND date = ?
    ),
    replay(rn, history_rowid, before_total_yen, after_total_yen) AS (
      SELECT
        rn,
        history_rowid,
        0,
        input_yen
      FROM ordered
      WHERE rn = 1
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        ordered.rn,
        ordered.history_rowid,
        replay.after_total_yen,
        CASE
          WHEN ordered.operation_type = 'add'
            THEN replay.after_total_yen + ordered.input_yen
          ELSE ordered.input_yen
        END
      FROM replay
      JOIN ordered ON ordered.rn = replay.rn + 1
    )

      UPDATE daily_operation_histories
      SET
        before_total_yen = replay.before_total_yen,
        after_total_yen = replay.after_total_yen
      FROM replay
      WHERE daily_operation_histories.rowid = CAST(replay.history_rowid AS INTEGER)
        AND (
          daily_operation_histories.before_total_yen <> replay.before_total_yen
          OR daily_operation_histories.after_total_yen <> replay.after_total_yen
        )

delete from "daily_totals" where ("daily_totals"."budget_period_id" = ? and "daily_totals"."date" = ? and not exists (select 1 from "daily_operation_histories" where ("daily_operation_histories"."budget_period_id" = ? and "daily_operation_histories"."date" = ?)))

insert into "daily_totals" ("budget_period_id", "date", "year_month", "total_used_yen", "updated_at") select ? as "budget_period_id", ? as "date", ? as "year_month", "after_total_yen", ? as "updated_at" from "daily_operation_histories" where ("daily_operation_histories"."budget_period_id" = ? and "daily_operation_histories"."date" = ?) order by "daily_operation_histories"."created_at" desc, rowid desc limit ? on conflict ("daily_totals"."budget_period_id", "daily_totals"."date") do update set "year_month" = excluded."year_month", "total_used_yen" = excluded."total_used_yen", "updated_at" = excluded."updated_at"
